golden_set.written_by: Group 10, by hand from the frozen record values
golden_set.composition: 10 well-formed records, 5 boundary records (2 with an uncertain date, 1 with a disjunctive culture, 2 that must be refused)
golden_set.expected_facts: Each case lists the record values a correct label must restate word for word, plus medium keywords. Nothing else may appear in the label as a fact.
golden_set.notes: An expectation is met only if the string occurs in the label exactly. Dates keep the museum's own hedges (ca., (?) ) and cultures keep their disjunction.
